chapter.verse: Khatvei, Gennesaret Bual gei ah Jesu a din laitak Pasian' thu ngai nuamin mihonpi in Jesu nehcip uh hi.
Jesu in bual gei ah gunkuang nih mu a, ahi zongin ngabengte gunkuang pan pusuak khinin a ngente uh sawp uh hi.
Gunkuangte lakah Simon' a pen tungah Jesu tuang a, tuinawl leitang pan gunkuang tawmkhat khinphei dingin Simon cial hi. Tua ciangin Jesu tusuk a, gunkuang tungpanin mihonpi thuhilh hi.
Thugen a man ciangin Simon' kiangah, "Tui thukna lamah khin inla nga man dingin na ngente khuhsuk in," ci hi.
Simon in, "Topa aw, zan thapai ka hanciam uh a, khat zong ka man kei uh hi. Ahi zongin nong cih bangin ngen ka khuh ding hi," ci hi.
Ngen a khuh uh ciangin ngasa honmangpi khat awk a, a ngen uh kikek hi.
Tua ciangin gunkuang dang khat-a om naseppih lawmte hong pai-in a huh nadingun khut van hi. Amau zong hong pai-in ngasa a dimin guang uh ahih manin gunkuang nihte tui ah tum dektak hi.
Simon Peter in a muh ciangin Jesu' khuk gei-ah bok a, "Topa aw, mawhnei mi khat ka hih manin ka kiangpan paikhia in," ci hi.
A hang pen amah leh a gei-a omte khempeuh in ngasa tampi a mat uh lamdang sa mahmah uh hi.
Simon' kithuahpihte ahi Zebedee' tapa James leh John in zong lamdang sa uh hi. Jesu in Simon' kiangah, "Lau kei in. Tu-a kipan mi na man ding uh hi," ci hi.
A gunkuangte uh tuinawl piau a tunpih khit uh ciangin amaute in na khempeuh nusia-in Jesu zui uh hi.
Khuapi khat ah Jesu a om laitak a pumtangin vun natna vei mi khat hong pai hi. Jesu a muh ciangin boksukin thum a, "Topa aw, na ut nakleh kei nong siangsak thei ding hi," ci hi.
Jesu in a khut zankhia-in mipa lawng a, "Ka ut hi. Siang ta in!" ci hi. Thakhat thu-in vun natna in tua mipa paikhiatsan hi.

Tua ciangin kuamah' kiangah a gen loh nadingin tua mipa kham a, "Siampipa' kiangah pai-in va kilak inla na sianna hangin amaute' tungah muhtheih teci ahi dingin Moses' hong vaikhak biakpiaknac va luui in," ci hi.
Tu-in Jesu' thu kizel semsem a, ama' thugen ngai ding leh a natnate uh a kidamsak nadingin mihonpi tampitak hong kikhawm uh hi.
Ahih hangin gamlak simtham mun ah Jesu pai-in thungenin om hi.

Tua sawng ni khat, Jesu thu hilhcianin a om laitak, Galilee gam leh Judea gam sunga khua khempeuh pan leh Jerusalem pana hong pai Pharisee-te leh thukhun hilhcian syate tua lai-ah tu uh hi. Cina damsak nadingin Topa' vangliatna in Jesu ompih hi.
Tua ciangin, en un, mi kimkhat in pumzaw mi khat a lupna tawh hong zawng uh a, Jesu' kiang a lutpih theih nading uh leh a mai-ah a sial theih nadingun hanciam uh hi.
Mihonpi' huhau-in lut nading a muh loh uh ciangin innkhumf tungah kahto uh a, tungkhuh leisan phelte kalkhia-in mihonpi laizang Jesu' mai-ah pumzawpa a lupna pheek tawh khaisuk uh hi.
Jesu in tua mite' upna a muh ciangin "Lawm aw, na mawhnate hong kimaisak hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin laisiamte leh Pharisee-te in, "Pasian daisakna kam a pau hih mipa kua ahi hiam? Pasian longal kua in mawhna maisak thei ahi hiam?" ci-in ngaihsun uh hi.
Jesu in amaute' ngaihsut thu a theih ciangin, "Bang hangin na lungsim sung uhah tuaci ngaihsut na hi uh hiam?
Na mawhnate hong kimaisak hi,' cih ding leh, 'Tho inla lampai in,' cih ding, koi baihzaw ahi hiam?
Mihing' Tapa in leitung ah mawhmaisak nading hihtheihna thu nei cih na theih nadingun""”a cih kawmin pumzaw mipa' kiangah"”"Tho inla na lupna pheek la-in na inn ah ciahsuak in, kong ci hi," ci hi.
Tua mipa zong thakhat thu-in amaute' mai-ah tho pah a, amah a kisialna taal la-in Pasian phat kawmin a inn ah ciah hi.
Amau zong a vekun lamdangsakna tawh kidim uh a, Pasian phat uh hi. Launa in phu ahih manin, "Tuni-in thu namtuampi khat i mu hi," ci uh hi.
Tua khit Jesu paikhia-in siahdong buk sunga tu Levi minnei siahdongpa a muh ciangin, "Hong zui in," ci hi.
Levi zong dingto a, na khempeuh nusia-in Jesu zui hi.
Tua ciangin Levi in a inn ah Jesu pahtawina anne pawipi khat bawl a, tua takah siahdong honpi khat leh midangte zong amau tawh ankuang uumkhawm uh hi.
Nungzuite' kiangah Pharisee-te leh a laisiamte uh phun uh a, "Bang hangin siahdongte leh mawhneite tawh an nekhawm tui dawnkhawm na hi uh hiam?" ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, "Cidamte zato siampu kisam lo uh a, cinate bek kisam uh hi.
Kei pen midikte a sam ding hilo-in mawhneite kisikna sung a tunpih dingin hong pai ka hi hi," ci hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in Jesu' kiangah, "John' nungzuite in an tang zelzelin thungetna nei uh a, Pharisee-te' nungzuite zong tua dan mah hinapi nang' ate ahihleh anne tuidawnin om uh hi," ci uh hi.
Jesu in, "Zipi tangvalpa a om sungin mopawisiim lawmlegual teng antangsak thei laizang ding na hi uh hiam?
Amaute' kiangpan zipi tangvalpa a kipaikhiatpih ding hunlenite hong tung ding a, tua hun ciangin amaute in an tang ding uh hi," ci hi.

Tua banah thugenteh khat hih bangin genbeh lai hi: "Kuamah in puahsilh a lui phop nadingin puansilh a thak pan puanbekno eu-khia ngeilo hi. Eu-khia hileh puan thak pen puankek suak ding banah a thak pana puanbek zong a lui tawh kituak lo lai ding hi.
Tua dan mahin kuamah in savun-uum lui sungah lengtui thak thun ngeilo hi. Thun hileh lengtui thak in savun-uum phukham ding a, lengtui bua ding banah savun-uum zong kisia ding hi.
Lengtui thak pen savun-uum thak ah kithun hi.
Tua hi a, lengtui a lui a dawn khit uh nungah a thak a lunggulh kuamah om lo a, 'A lui pen lim hi,' ci uh hi."Jesu, Sabbath Topa
